monitor-researcher.description: Weekly upstream ecosystem research orchestrator. Researches new opencode ecosystem features, GitHub Actions updates, MCP SDK changes and competitor AI-review tool capabilities, then orchestrates lane researchers and emits findings JSON conforming to .github/schemas/monitor-findings.schema.json. Output is pure JSON on stdout (no markdown fences, no commentary) so CI can parse it deterministically.

monitor-lane-researcher.description: Single-lane upstream researcher. Investigates one research lane (core, competitor, security, user-voice, code-audit, benchmark, compatibility, reviewer) within the trust boundary allowlist, collects evidence with version+published dates, and reports structured findings back to the orchestrator. Never edits files.

monitor-issue-publisher.description: Publishes validated monitor findings as GitHub issues via the gh CLI only. Creates one issue per Tier-A finding with the deterministic [Monitor][category] title, evidence footer comment, and risk-based labels (monitor, monitor-epic, autofix-trigger). Never edits files, never fetches web content.
